services.name: Biloxi Fishing Trips
services.desc: Fish-On Charters operates from March through October, offering the best sportfishing opportunities in Biloxi, Mississippi. Depending on the season, we run Red Snapper, Barrier Island, and Inshore Trips. With a variety of options for every angler, it's a great way to fill the freezer or enjoy a day on the water. We took some guys from work on a longer then usual red snapper trip and did Capt Kenny put us on the fish. Largest red snapper I’ve ever seen in my life. The boat was clean and the deckhands were top notch. We had 2 guys who had never been offshore fishing and the deckhand had them getting the 20 pound snappers in the boat in no time. We will fish with them again!! I recommend anyone
